description: Take a high-DPI (2x) screenshot of the current frame and save it as a PNG in the output directory. Works any time during a session — element-only via selector, or full_page for the whole scroll height. Returns the file path. Clear captions/rings first unless you want them in the shot.

full_page.description: true captures the entire scroll height, not just the visible viewport. Optional; default false. Ignored when selector is set.

name.description: File name without extension; slugified to lowercase-dashes. e.g. 'dashboard-hero' → dashboard-hero.png in the output dir. Reused names overwrite.

selector.description: Capture just this element (CSS selector) instead of the viewport. Optional. When set, full_page is ignored.

name: studio_screenshot
